title: P0: StrategyPackage manifest_sha256 drift blocks Selection Center and Paper v2/MiniQMT readiness
description: StrategyPackage manifest/hash drift blocks package discovery, Selection Center selectable package enumeration, fresh daily selection evidence generation, and safe Paper v2 LocalSim/MiniQMT simulation readiness for affected packages.
required_verification: Diagnostic enumerates all package_id/version records with manifest_sha256 drift and reports current binding impact.
Approved repair/quarantine workflow has durable audit evidence and rollback/restore procedure; no silent hash overwrite.
Affected package detail endpoints either load successfully after repair or return explicit quarantine metadata without blocking unrelated packages.
Fresh daily selection evidence is generated for target LocalSim/MiniQMT packages before execution.
Regression tests cover repository validation and corrupt-package isolation/quarantine behavior.
BUG registry JSON and GitHub issue remain synchronized.
closure_requirements: No stale 2026-05-20 selection binding is used as a Monday 2026-05-25 trading signal.
Current MiniQMT POC strategies either point to repaired valid packages with fresh selection evidence or are explicitly disabled/quarantined.
Selection Center package discovery is not globally blocked by one corrupt historical package unless the selected package itself is corrupt.
Any production data repair is reviewed, audited, and separately verified before claiming unattended readiness.
The fix report includes production_ddl_gate, production_backend_dependency_gate, and production_frontend_dependency_gate.

events.note: Mirrored to GitHub issue #172 because Validation MCP sync is currently blocked by an unrelated UTF-8 BOM parse error in a stale worktree registry entry.
Found during Paper v2 readiness audit for unattended AIstock selection, LocalSim paper trading, and MiniQMT paper-sim operation.

Audit keeps BUG-103 open: 6650cc64 isolated/quarantined corrupt package drift and added manifest-integrity/repair APIs, but live /api/v1/strategy-packages/manifest-integrity?limit=500 still reports drifted_count=10. Operator-reviewed production repair/quarantine evidence and fresh daily selection evidence are still required.
Expanded BUG-103 repair scope to include the StrategyPackage router endpoint that passes explicit manifest hash confirmation fields to the service layer; no production data mutation is performed.

non_goals: This registry-only commit does not implement the fix.
Do not start or restart production backend as part of issue registration.
Do not mutate production StrategyPackage data or submit MiniQMT orders as part of issue registration.
